handoff.lineage: selectedCandidateId -> handoffId -> uploadedSourceSha256 -> intakeCandidateId -> generated base/artifacts

candidateFirewall.unknownRights: may be shown as a user-mediated lead but never auto-acquired

scratchCanary.backupRestore: not newly exercised by this metadata-only slice
